intro: Pagefind's search runtime (dist/pagefind/v.*/wasm.en.pagefind and wasm.unknown.pagefind) is WebAssembly compiled
from Pagefind's pagefind_web crate (MIT, Pagefind's own licence, above) and the Rust crates below. Pagefind
publishes no third-party notices for it; these were collected for Pagefind 1.5.2 from pagefind_web/Cargo.lock
Unless its entry says otherwise, each crate's text was taken from its repository at the commit its crates.io package names
(.cargo_vcs_info.json) and is identical to the file in that package (sha256 as in Cargo.lock).
Where a crate is offered under MIT OR Apache-2.0, it is used here under MIT. Crates listed "in case any of it
is linked" are dependencies whose code may be removed entirely by the optimiser; their notices are kept anyway.

crates.name: wasm-bindgen-shared
crates.note: A dependency of wasm-bindgen. Its LICENSE-MIT is a link to the repository's, given here.

crates.name: unicode-ident
crates.note: A dependency of wasm-bindgen-shared; listed in case any of it is linked. Its LICENSE-MIT has no copyright line.

crates.name: once_cell
crates.note: A dependency of wasm-bindgen. Its LICENSE-MIT has no copyright line; the crate's Cargo.toml names Aleksey Kladov as author.

crates.name: serde
crates.note: Cargo.lock lists it as a dependency of bit-vec (an optional one); listed in case any of it is linked. Its LICENSE-MIT has no copyright line.

crates.name: serde_core
crates.note: A dependency of serde; listed for the same reason. Its LICENSE-MIT has no copyright line.

crates.name: pagefind_stem
crates.note: Ships no licence file. Its notices are the header of its src/lib.rs, reproduced below: the rust-stemmers API (MIT) and the Snowball stemmers (BSD-3-Clause), whose second clause asks for this notice with a binary redistribution.

crates.name: write-json
crates.note: Its LICENSE-MIT has no copyright line; the crate's Cargo.toml names Aleksey Kladov as author.

crates.name: pagefind_microjson
crates.note: Declared GPL-3.0-only in its Cargo.toml; the notice in its src/lib.rs says version 3 "or (at your option) any later version". Both notices are reproduced as published. The crate's LICENCE file is the GPL-3.0 text up to "END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS" (identical in https://github.com/rspencer01/microjson/blob/0a19858180bf7688e689bf982ea444c30d981594/LICENCE); the full text from gnu.org follows.
correspondingSource: https://static.crates.io/crates/pagefind_microjson/pagefind_microjson-0.1.4.crate (sha256 8f97aa64cde14e78d6274c473f36cec98d401f0b583282055e953d2df907e210, as in Pagefind's Cargo.lock), built from commit 51e27c165e26c7125666403b796fb5d8564a8be5 (the package's .cargo_vcs_info.json), a commit not in the public repository https://github.com/rspencer01/microjson; the crate file above is the exact source.
